question:
From the given options, select the homonym that corresponds to both Definition (P) and Definition (Q).

 

(P) The process by which a cell or molecule absorbs and integrates an external substance into its own physical structure

 

(Q) The legal process of officially forming and registering a new corporation or business entity
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प 2 अर्थात् Incorporation है।

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• Incorporation (noun) के दोनों अर्थ हैं: (P) किसी वस्तु को किसी शरीर या प्रणाली में ग्रहण करने या अवशोषित करने की क्रिया (जैसे किसी पदार्थ का कोशिका में समावेशन, incorporation), और (Q) निगम (corporation) के गठन की विधिक प्रक्रिया (जैसे कंपनी का certificate of incorporation, निगमन प्रमाणपत्र)।

 

• अतः Incorporation दोनों परिभाषाओं में बैठता है।

 

अतः, सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Assimilation (आत्मसात्करण) – (P) में बैठता है (अवशोषण और एकीकरण) परंतु विधिक अर्थ (Q) में नहीं।

 

• Option 3: Calcination (भस्मीकरण) – किसी पदार्थ को उच्च तापमान तक गर्म करना; असंबंधित।

 

• Option 4: Acquisition (अधिग्रहण) – कुछ प्राप्त करना, जैसे कंपनी खरीदना; नई इकाई का गठन नहीं।

 

NOTE

 

• Homonym (समनामी शब्द) वह शब्द है जिसके एक से अधिक अर्थ हों; यहाँ एक ही शब्द जैविक और विधिक दोनों परिभाषाओं में बैठता है।

question:
Read the following sentence and ascertain whether the underlined idiom is used correctly. If the usage is incorrect, choose the correct option (A/B/C) to suitably replace it. If the usage is correct, choose Option D: “No correction required.”

 

The evolutionary biologist expected his radical paper on genetic editing to spark a civil debate, but upon publication, he was forced to rule the roost as peers from every major research institute unleashed a barrage of harsh critiques, public reprimands, and demands for its retraction.
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प 2 अर्थात् to run the gauntlet है।

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "To rule the roost" का अर्थ है किसी समूह में प्रभावशाली व्यक्ति होना – यह कठोर आलोचना का सामना कर रहे वैज्ञानिक पर उपयुक्त नहीं बैठता।

 

• "To run the gauntlet" का अर्थ है आक्रमणों या आलोचना की श्रृंखला (एक कठिन परीक्षा, ordeal) से गुज़रना – यह आलोचनाओं और फटकारों की बौछार का सामना कर रहे जीवविज्ञानी पर उपयुक्त बैठता है। (कठिन परीक्षा से गुज़रना)

◦ Example: Whistleblowers often run the gauntlet of public hostility.

 

• वाक्य बनता है: "… he was forced to run the gauntlet as peers … unleashed a barrage of harsh critiques …"।

 

अतः, सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: To drop the ball – जो करना चाहिए था उसे न करके गलती करना।

 

• Option 3: To cast the die – अपरिवर्तनीय निर्णय लेना ("the die is cast")।

 

• Option 4: "No correction required" गलत है क्योंकि "rule the roost" का प्रयोग गलत है।

 

NOTE

 

• मुहावरा: gauntlet एक पुराने सैन्य दंड से आया है जिसमें एक व्यक्ति को पुरुषों की दो पंक्तियों के बीच से दौड़ना पड़ता था, जो उसे मारते थे।

question: Identify the option in which the idiom “to pass the buck” has been used correctly.
option_1: The biology department passed the buck by securing an external federal grant that covered all tuition costs for their incoming doctoral candidates.
option_2: The financial committee managed to pass the buck by converting the university's surplus cash reserves into low-yield, highly secure government bonds.
option_3: Instead of taking accountability for the data breach, the chief information officer sought to pass the buck by blaming a junior contractor's outdated software patch.
option_4: The provost advised the academic senate to pass the buck by designing a highly rigorous curriculum that challenged the undergraduate students.
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प 3 अर्थात् Instead of taking accountability for the data breach, the chief information officer sought to pass the buck by blaming a junior contractor's outdated software patch. है।

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "To pass the buck" का अर्थ है उत्तरदायित्व या दोष किसी और पर डाल देना। (ज़िम्मेदारी दूसरे पर डालना)

◦ Example: Don't pass the buck – admit your mistake.

 

• Option 3: अधिकारी जवाबदेही से बचता है और एक कनिष्ठ ठेकेदार को दोषी ठहराता है → मुहावरे का प्रयोग सही है।

 

अतः, सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

 

Additional Information

 

• विकल्प 1, 2 और 4 अनुदान प्राप्त करने, बॉन्ड में निवेश करने और पाठ्यक्रम बनाने का वर्णन करते हैं – किसी में भी दोष या उत्तरदायित्व दूसरे पर डालना नहीं है।

 

• उत्पत्ति: "buck" पोकर में अगले डीलर को दिया जाने वाला एक चिह्न था; हैरी ट्रूमैन की मेज़ पर लगे संकेत में लिखा था, "The buck stops here."

 

NOTE

 

• संबंधित मुहावरे: "to shift the blame", "to pass the parcel", "to buck up" (उत्साहित होना) – इन्हें भ्रमित न करें।

question: Read the sentences provided in options A, B, C, and D carefully. Three of these sentences contain distinct grammatical, logical or structural errors. Select the single option that represents a grammatically correct, logically coherent, and structurally sound sentence.
option_1: The ethics board explicitly stated that the oncology lab was authorised to test the experimental genetic compound only on non-human primates, but the lead researcher bypassed protocol by administering the substance to terminal human patients, causing the university to lose its federal funding permanently.
option_2: Following an anonymous whistleblower report regarding offshore tax shelters, the regulatory agency almost flagged every foreign wire transfer processed by the investment bank during the third quarter, triggering an unprecedented internal investigation by the compliance department.
option_3: Satellite imagery compiled by the polar research institute over the last decade indicates that the ancient subglacial lake has lost total half of its core ice mass, an alarming metric that suggests global thermal acceleration is occurring far more rapidly than previously simulated.
option_4: Due to the seamless integration of algorithmic micro-investing features within the mobile application, the financial technology platform captured direct three-quarters of the millennial market share within its first twelve months of deployment, thoroughly outperforming its legacy banking competitors.
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प 1 अर्थात् The ethics board explicitly stated that the oncology lab was authorised to test the experimental genetic compound only on non-human primates, but the lead researcher bypassed protocol by administering the substance to terminal human patients, causing the university to lose its federal funding permanently. है।

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• Option 1 (A) व्याकरणिक रूप से सही और तार्किक रूप से सुसंगत है: काल (tenses) एकरूप हैं, "only on non-human primates" सही पदबंध को संशोधित करता है, और कारण–प्रभाव की शृंखला स्पष्ट है।

 

• अन्य विकल्पों में त्रुटियाँ:

◦ Option 2: misplaced modifier (अस्थानस्थ विशेषक) – "almost flagged every foreign wire transfer" का अर्थ निकलता है कि एजेंसी ने लगभग चिह्नित कर ही दिया था; अभीष्ट अर्थ है "flagged almost every foreign wire transfer"।

◦ Option 3: "lost total half" गलत है – यह "lost a total of half" या "lost fully half" होना चाहिए।

◦ Option 4: "captured direct three-quarters" गलत है – "direct" (adjective) का प्रयोग क्रियाविशेषण (adverb) "directly" के स्थान पर किया गया है ; संरचना दोषपूर्ण है।

 

अतः, सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

 

Additional Information

 

• "only" और "almost" की स्थिति: इन्हें उस शब्द के ठीक पहले रखिए जिसे ये संशोधित करते हैं।

 

• "Direct" (adjective) बनाम "directly" (adverb): क्रिया "captured" को संशोधित करने के लिए adverb चाहिए।

 

NOTE

 

• सुझाव: "एकमात्र सही वाक्य" वाले प्रश्नों में पहले प्रत्येक विकल्प की स्पष्ट त्रुटि पहचानिए और उन्हें हटाइए।

question:
Read the two sentences given below carefully. Identify which of them contains a grammatical error.

 

P: After the Supreme Court rejected their final statutory appeal, the board of directors resigned themselves to losing their proprietary vaccine patent rights.

Q: The eccentric quantitative fund manager was given to executing high-risk volatility trades during periods of extreme global market contraction.
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प 4 अर्थात् Neither P nor Q है।

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• वाक्य P: "resigned themselves to losing" – वाक्यांश "resign oneself to (+ noun/gerund)" का अर्थ है किसी अप्रिय बात को स्वीकार कर लेना; आत्मवाचक सर्वनाम (reflexive pronoun) बहुवचन कर्ता "board of directors" (व्यक्तियों के रूप में माना गया) से मेल खाता है → सही।

 

• वाक्य Q: "was given to executing" – "be given to (+ gerund/noun)" का अर्थ है कोई काम करने की आदत होना → सही।

 

• किसी भी वाक्य में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि नहीं है।

 

अतः, सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

 

Additional Information

 

• समान वाक्यांश: be addicted to doing, be accustomed to doing, be used to doing, be prone to doing।

question:
Find the grammatically sound direct speech representation of the indirect sentence from the options below.

 

Nandita told Abhay that if they had not hurried out of the room, they would not have come back so soon pushing those tall wire carts full of babies for him to review.
option_1: Nandita told Abhay, "If we have not hurried out of the room, we will not have come back so soon pushing those tall wire carts full of babies for you to have reviewed."
option_2: Nandita told Abhay, "If we have not hurried out of the room, we would not have come back so soon pushing those tall wire carts full of babies for you to be reviewing."
option_3: Nandita told Abhay, "If we had not hurried out of the room, we will not have come back so soon pushing those tall wire carts full of babies for you having reviewed."
option_4: Nandita told Abhay, "If we had not hurried out of the room, we would not have come back so soon pushing those tall wire carts full of babies for you to review."
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प 4 अर्थात् Nandita told Abhay, "If we had not hurried out of the room, we would not have come back so soon pushing those tall wire carts full of babies for you to review." है।

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• यह तृतीय शर्त वाक्य (third conditional) है (अतीत का अवास्तविक): "If + past perfect, would + have + V3"। प्रत्यक्ष कथन (direct speech) में यह काल नहीं बदलता क्योंकि यह पहले से ही काल्पनिक अतीत है: "If we had not hurried …, we would not have come back …"।

 

• सर्वनाम परिवर्तन: "they" → "we" (नंदिता स्वयं को सम्मिलित करती है); "him" → "you" (अभय को संबोधित किया जा रहा है); "for him to review" → "for you to review"।

 

• अतः Option 4 सही है।

 

अतः, सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 और Option 2 में "have not hurried" (present perfect) का प्रयोग है – conditional काल गलत ढंग से बदला गया है।

 

• Option 1 और 3 में "will not have come" है – एक भविष्य रूप जो अतीत की काल्पनिक स्थिति से मेल नहीं खाता।

 

• Option 3: "for you having reviewed", Option 1: "to have reviewed" और Option 2: "to be reviewing", "for him to review" का भाव बदल देते हैं।

 

NOTE

 

• Conditional के प्रकार याद रखिए: Type 1 – If + present, will; Type 2 – If + past, would; Type 3 – If + past perfect, would have + V3।

• मुहावरे: iron out the creases/wrinkles (समस्याएँ दूर करना); rule out (बाहर करना); check out (जाँच करना/होटल छोड़ना)।

Complete the following passage by filling in the blanks with the most appropriate words from the options given below.

 

In increasingly interdependent ecosystems, trust is no longer a soft virtue but a strategic asset that determines institutional resilience. While many organizations profess commitment to transparency, such declarations often fail to _ (A) under scrutiny when operational opacity persists beneath performative disclosure. Moreover, stakeholders are increasingly unwilling to _ (B) rhetorical assurances, particularly when prior breaches of confidence have not been adequately redressed. This skepticism is further amplified in digital environments where information asymmetry and rapid dissemination of partial narratives distort institutional intent. In such contexts, leaders must _ (C) reputational capital with caution, as overextension of goodwill may precipitate a rapid erosion of legitimacy. Nevertheless, trust deficits, once entrenched, do not easily _ (D) through cosmetic reforms or episodic outreach initiatives. Such dynamics underscore the importance of aligning formal governance structures with informal norms of accountability. Consequently, reputational repair requires sustained behavioral consistency rather than episodic signaling exercises that merely project responsiveness without substantive change. Therefore, institutions that consistently align incentives with ethical imperatives are more likely to _ (E) enduring legitimacy across shifting socio-political landscapes. Without such alignment, even well-designed frameworks risk gradual erosion of stakeholder confidence.

 

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank (E).
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प 2 अर्थात् command है।

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• रिक्त स्थान (E): "institutions that consistently align incentives with ethical imperatives are more likely to _ enduring legitimacy" – command (verb) का अर्थ है (सम्मान, निष्ठा, वैधता) के योग्य होना और उसे प्राप्त करना। (हासिल करना, प्रभावी रूप से पाना)

◦ Example: She commands great respect among her colleagues.

 

• वाक्य इस प्रकार पढ़ा जाता है: "…more likely to command enduring legitimacy across shifting socio-political landscapes."

 

अतः, सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

 

Additional Information

 

• compromise – कमज़ोर करना या हानि पहुँचाना (जैसे compromise security); confine – सीमित करना; contest – विवाद करना। ये वाक्य को अतार्किक बना देंगे (नैतिकता के साथ प्रोत्साहनों को जोड़ने वाली संस्थाएँ वैधता से "compromise" या "contest" नहीं करेंगी)।

 

NOTE

 

• Command के साथ सहप्रयोग (Collocations): command respect, command attention, command a high price, command a majority।
